senses.gloss: to offer. Y. Bets. V, end 63ᵇ אוֹקְרֵיה חד סרקיי כמהין a Saracen sent him mushrooms as a present (on a Holy Day). Y. B. Bath. II, end, 13ᶜ אוֹקְרַת תאנין וכ׳ brought R. … figs as a present; a. fr.—[
